description:
This is a port of the game over theme that plays when you die in "(Mario) The Music Box." "(Mario) The Music Box" was created by Team Ari.

Best used for game over theme. Pretty obvious. Should also be used with
this patch
https://www.smwcentral.net/?p=section&a=details&id=4862


Also, play (Mario) The Music Box!
